item.title: Sega vs. Capcom new trailer reveals more characters, improved visuals, Third Strike announcer and a launch for the fan game
item.description: <p>The fan developers in the fighting game community will never cease to amaze whether it be for character mods or actual game projects.</p> <p><a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2023/nov/01/sega-capcom-fan-project-showcase/">Sega vs. Capcom: The Next Level</a> has now received a new trailer for the start of 2026, and the fan-made crossover fighting game is now looking and sounding better than ever.</p>

item.title: Over 240 days have passed after Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls was first revealed without a single new character since then
item.description: <p><a href='https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/jun/04/marvel-tokon-fighting-arcsys/'>Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls</a> was announced on June 4, 2025 during the PlayStation State of Play event that aired that day. As such, it's been over 240 days since Captain America, Iron Man, Storm, Dr. Doom, Star-Lord, Ms. Marvel, Spider-Man and Ghost Rider were revealed.</p> <p>The developers have not revealed a single character since those initial eight. item.title: Street Fighter legends Nemo and Itabashi Zangief relive their eternal rivalry with laughs and disrespectful handshakes
item.description: <p>One of the great things about the normal 1v1 aspect of fighting games is that it can set up rivalries between players that can span multiple events or even years though it feels like we don't see as much of that these days.</p> <p>There is one eternal rivalry that will never likely be extinguished at least between DFM|Itabashi Zangief and GLOE|Nemo.</p>

item.title: 2XKO Version 1.1.2 patch notes released
item.description: <p><a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/jan/19/season-1-patch-notes-2xko/">2XKO launched in full</a> last month with some issues, and the developers are fixing some of them now.</p> <p>Riot Games has now released the patch notes for 2XKO's Version 1.1.2 update being made available today.</p>

item.title: The King of Fighters stars are crossing over to... PUBG Mobile?
item.description: <p>Crossovers are still all the rage in the fighting game scene right now, and that includes a bunch of properties sitting far outside of the genre.</p> <p>Krafton recently announced and launched their latest collaboration for PUBG Mobile with The King of Fighters.</p>

item.title: Mod makes Boyfriend from Friday Night Funkin' playable in Super Smash Bros. Ultimate with his own unique moveset
item.description: <p><a href='https://www.eventhubs.com/moves/ssbu/'>Super Smash Bros. Ultimate</a> features a roster made up of 86 fighters. Though it can be argued that the game already has plenty of characters, fans have been adding unique movesets thanks to the power of modding.</p> <p>Back in 2020, the rhythm game Friday Night Funkin' was released on Newgrounds. item.title: Frosty Faustings champion releases both character and team tier lists for 2XKO after winning first big major
item.description: <p>After finally launching in full last month, 2XKO just had its first big offline major tournament this past weekend at <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/jan/25/frosty-faustings-xviii-2026-results/">Frosty Faustings XVIII</a>.</p> <p>Out of more than 850 players who signed up, ONi|<a href="https://x.com/bleedBTW/status/2019195312301322346">Bleed</a> was the one to walk away victorious in the League of Legends fighter.</p>

item.title: PlayStation's Critics' Choice sale offers up Tekken 8, Street Fighter 6 DLC, Mortal Kombat 1 and plenty more fighting game deals
item.description: <p><a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/jan/08/2026-fighting-games-guide/">2026 is shaping up to be a very busy year for fighting game fans</a>, and you can save a chunk of money on the biggest titles around right now.</p> <p>PlayStation is currently running both Critics' Choice and Hot Deals sales that are offering up quite a few nice fighter discounts worth checking out.</p>

item.title: Capcom's updated best-selling rankings reveal Street Fighter 6 ahead of Street fighter 2, Marvel vs Capcom collection boost
item.description: <p>While many studios across the video game industry have been struggling at least a bit as of late, Capcom is continuing to steamroll forward ahead with high sales.</p> <p>Capcom just updated their <a href="https://www.capcom.co.jp/ir/english/business/million.html#tab2">Platinum Titles list</a> of their best-selling video games, and some of their fighting games saw a boost <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/nov/06/capcom-updated-fighter-sales/">over their previous report</a>.</p>
